# Easy Share Code UK

## About
Easy Share Code is a free iOS app that helps UK eVisa holders store, manage, and access their Home Office share codes securely. The app allows users to add their share code to Apple Wallet for instant offline access.

## Key Features
- Store UK eVisa share codes in Apple Wallet
- Offline access to share codes (no internet needed)
- Expiry reminders (30, 60, 90 day validity tracking)
- QR code display for quick verification
- Store unlimited codes for family members
- Available in 32 languages

## Use Cases
- Prove right to work to employers
- Prove right to rent to landlords
- Show immigration status at UK border
- Quick access during job interviews or property viewings

## Who Is It For
- UK eVisa holders
- People with settled or pre-settled status (EUSS)
- Anyone with digital immigration status in the UK
- Families managing multiple share codes

## How It Works
1. Generate your share code on GOV.UK
2. Enter it in the Easy Share Code app
3. Add to Apple Wallet for instant access
4. Get reminded before it expires

## Links

## FAQ
Q: How do I store my UK share code in Apple Wallet?
A: Download the Easy Share Code app from the App Store, enter your share code, and tap "Add to Apple Wallet". Your code will be accessible offline from your iPhone's Wallet app.

Q: Is there an app to save my UK eVisa share code?
A: Yes, Easy Share Code is a free iOS app specifically designed to store UK Home Office share codes. It supports Apple Wallet integration, expiry reminders, and offline access.

Q: How long is a UK share code valid?
A: Share codes have different validity periods: 30 days for right to work, 60 days for right to rent, and 90 days for other checks. The Easy Share Code app tracks these expiry dates and sends reminders.

Q: Can I store multiple share codes for my family?
A: Yes, the Easy Share Code app (Premium plan, £2.99/year) allows you to store unlimited share codes for all family members in one place.

Q: Does the app work without internet?
A: Yes, once your share code is saved and added to Apple Wallet, you can access it completely offline — useful at airports or during property viewings with no signal.
